accepted_joins.rule: A join is drawn only where the GSPC instrument measures the same adversarial family; overlap, never equivalence (indirect/tool-mediated payloads are outside the bank).

unmapped.rule: No GSPC axis measures the category's quantity; each category carries its unmapped_reason verbatim in the mapping artifact.

functions/api/_gspc_axes_a.ts: safety = calibrated refusal on paired requests, DefBench
accepted_joins.rule: Join only refusal-family hazards to the calibrated-refusal instrument; refusal calibration is not a per-hazard verdict (caveat carried on the page).

no_join.rule: IP regurgitation, defamation, privacy leakage and advice quality are not refusal calibration; no GSPC axis measures them, so the page shows 'no GSPC axis'.

nevers: never a fused grade (floating baseline is not comparable across time)

pyrit.rule: PyRIT output attaches to the jail instrument as content-hashed evidence (ATTACHED, never MEASURED); keyword-refusal scoring is deliberately not implemented (playbookAudit pyrit bind).
